_comment: Known answers for every real customer job we hold. A new job goes in
here the day it arrives, and from then on every future change has to
keep every earlier job right. That is the whole point: the last three
fixes each came from ONE job breaking, and a fix that quietly moves a
different board's number is not a fix.
Two tiers, and the difference matters.
witnessed  — a human or a machine outside Prism says so. The
customer's own check sheet, or the CAM report shipped
inside the job. These are CORRECTNESS: if one breaks,
locked     — no outside witness, so this is only what Prism reads
today. These are REGRESSION: if one moves, something
changed and somebody has to say whether it improved.
Never promote a locked value to witnessed without an actual witness.
A job marked `slow` is skipped unless PRISM_SLOW_TESTS=1 is set. The
twelve-layer board takes five minutes to measure, which is fine for a
customer waiting on an answer and not fine on every test run. Run the
slow ones before shipping a change to the geometry.

layer 1.zip.what: 2013 single-sided, job 101942. Drill arrives as a Gerber of flashed pads; copper is G36 regions; four-digit D-codes.
layer 1.zip.witness: the customer's own hand-filled check sheet (photographed 2026-08-20), and 101942 (2).xlsx which states 60mm x 73mm

CAM for EI-500DT-CYP-TOP-001-V2 ERP53.ra.what: 2018 Altium four-layer, inches, Excellon drill, two internal planes, an octagonal outline.
CAM for EI-500DT-CYP-TOP-001-V2 ERP53.ra.witness: the customer's check sheet, plus the job's own .DRR report stating 218 holes across ten tools

2-547-161A_Gerber.zip.what: Eight copper layers, four planes, three drill files (plated, non-plated, board-edge rout), pads drawn as %AM rotated-rectangle macros.
2-547-161A_Gerber.zip.witness: the job's own .DRR report: eight tools, 592 holes, smallest 0.15mm

CT-TT-CAP12-V1.1-FAB (1).zip.what: A PANEL, not a board — 196x195mm carrying many copies. 4 routed layers, 2855 holes. Read clean on the first attempt, the only job so far that did.

MIE V2.2 GERBER with STACKUP 250502 1701.what: PADS export, 10 copper layers, every file named art001.pho. Two drill files with tool selects written as T1C.01969F095S3.
MIE V2.2 GERBER with STACKUP 250502 1701.witness: two Drill Sizes Reports: 8 non-plated + 1169 plated = 1177 holes

PCB-219920263564-00 PCB FAB PKG.zip.what: PADS export, 12 copper layers, 187,674 traces on one of them — the job that made speed matter. Drill file has no M48 header at all.
PCB-219920263564-00 PCB FAB PKG.zip.witness: its Drill Sizes Report: 3501 holes across 11 tools
